notes.title: Update 0.4.0 - Complete Visual Rework
notes.notes:
Hello,
I am happy to announce that the visual rework of the game is finished and ready to be released. It features new textures and new models. 

Other notable Changes:
-> Changed some of the lanes for better playability.
-> Added new Sound Effects.
-> Added new Visual Effects.
-> Improved ball speed accuracy
-> Added development info board in game.
-> Fixed some minor bugs.

Hope you like the update :)

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 - Pirates Course
notes.notes:
The Pirates Course Is Here

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34375661/60e3922bbdd2748c98ce3972e05cbaa884e4571b.jpg

Play minigolf on 18 pirates themed holes. Overcome different obstacles like rolling barrels, bombs and cannons.

Additional changes:
-> Ball movement should be more smooth.
-> Changed lobby board to improve usability.
